children: on Tuesday announced that higher doses of its blockbuster obesity therapy Zepbound generated additional weight loss compared with Wegovy HD, the high-dose version of Novo’s

Citing results from a new indirect comparison between the popular injectables, the U.S. drugmaker said that Zepbound 10 mg and 15 mg generated higher body weight reductions over 72 weeks compared with Wegovy HD.

According to the analysis, patients on Zepbound 15 mg and 10 mg, respectively, recorded 4.5% and 3.2% additional body weight on average, and those receiving Zepbound 15 mg were three times more likely to achieve 20% or higher weight reduction compared to those on Wegovy HD.

Presenting data at the ongoing annual meeting of the European Association for the Study of Diabetes, the Indiana-based pharma giant added that discontinuation rates due to adverse events were comparable among the recipients of Zepbound 15 mg, Zepbound 10 mg, and Wegovy HD.
The analysis was based on data from Lilly’s

STEP UP studies. The Phase 3 studies enrolled thousands of obese or overweight adults globally to evaluate 5 mg, 10 mg, and 15 mg of tirzepatide and Wegovy HD, respectively, in a bid to support regulatory submissions
